scripts.garbage-tidy:
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = --version ]; then exec {clang-tidy} "$@"; fi
echo 'not a diagnostic'
exit 0
scripts.next-rewriting-tidy:
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = --version ]; then exec {clang-tidy} "$@"; fi
case "$5" in */a.cpp) printf "\n" >> "${5%/a.cpp}/b.cpp";; esac
exec {clang-tidy} "$@"
scripts.rewriting-tidy:
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = --version ]; then exec {clang-tidy} "$@"; fi
{clang-tidy} "$@"
status=$?
printf "\n" >> "$5"
exit $status
scripts.touching-tidy:
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = --version ]; then exec {clang-tidy} "$@"; fi
touch "$0"
exec {clang-tidy} "$@"
